review:
Escape the Pyramid – Fire & Ice marks random positions with fire or ice on every spin. If the fire scatter lands on reel one, fire-marked positions become wilds. If the ice scatter lands on reel six, ice-marked positions turn into a random paying symbol and three respins begin, where Upgrade improves the chosen symbol and +1 adds a respin.

Landing both scatters at once triggers the Ice and Fire feature: every marked position turns wild and three respins are awarded, during which only blanks, sticky wilds and +1 spins can land. The in-game screens advertise up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.5%. A smart, original design.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
